title: Use the sidebar
summary: Browse document pages with thumbnails or jump through chapters using the Table of Contents.

sections.heading: Sidebar Views
sections.text: Click the sidebar header menu to choose Thumbnails, Contact Sheet, or Table of Contents.

sections.heading: Thumbnail Resizing
sections.text: Drag the slider at the bottom of the sidebar to increase or decrease thumbnail preview size.

steps: Click the Sidebar button on the top toolbar or press Ctrl + B to open the sidebar.
Select Thumbnails to view a vertical strip of all pages.
Select Table of Contents to navigate PDF chapters and outline bookmarks.
note: Right-click any thumbnail card to access quick page rotation, duplicate, insert, and delete commands.
